def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    dividend_year_1 = 0.5
    dividend_year_2 = 0.5
    growth_rate = 0.06
    required_rate_of_return = 0.10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    dividend_year_3 = dividend_year_2 * (1 + growth_rate)
    terminal_value_year_2 = dividend_year_3 / (required_rate_of_return - growth_rate)

    present_value_year_1 = dividend_year_1 / (1 + required_rate_of_return)
    present_value_year_2 = dividend_year_2 / (1 + required_rate_of_return) ** 2
    present_value_terminal_value = terminal_value_year_2 / (1 + required_rate_of_return) ** 2

    equity_value = (
        present_value_year_1
        + present_value_year_2
        + present_value_terminal_value
    )

    # Return answer
    return round(equity_value, 3)
